# Phoenix Skills
> Cross-agent skills repository for Phoenix, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, OpenCode, and any Python-compatible AI agent.

## Project Structure
- Skills registry: `registry.json` (index of all skills)
- Installer: `install.py` (CLI for installing skills)
- Skills:
  - `skills/web-search/` - DuckDuckGo web search (no API key)
  - `skills/github/` - GitHub operations via gh CLI/API
  - `skills/code-review/` - Security, complexity, style analysis
  - `skills/nemo-rl-auto-research/` - Automated RL research with Nemo

## Key Features
- Agent-agnostic: pure Python, works with any agent
- Self-contained: each skill has manifest, code, requirements
- Installable: `python install.py install <skill-name>`
- Cross-platform: Windows, Linux, macOS
- No framework lock-in: import and use directly
